name: ibkr-httpapi
description: HTTP+JSON bridge to Interactive Brokers via ib_async and a local IB Gateway container — market data, option chains with Greeks, account/positions, order entry, and server-side technical analysis over REST and MCP.

api_url.title: ibkr-httpapi URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your running ibkr-httpapi server, including the /v1 REST prefix, e.g. http://localhost:8889/v1. Sets IBKR_HTTPAPI_URL.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Only needed if the server was started with api_token / API_TOKEN configured. Sets API_TOKEN.
